reviewScope: Post-generation inter-clip cranial scale calibration authorized by the user on 2026-08-31. The factors do not alter generation reference locks or constitute artistic acceptance.

enemy-011-lurker.note: Three laterally comparable smooth cranial domes measured per clip. Longitudinal chord connects the posterior dome contour above the neck to its anterior rounded carapace tip, excluding jaw/teeth, dorsal pipes and tail. Small in-plane pitch changes are handled by Euclidean length. Variation within each clip remains; this is bounded median scale calibration, not redesign, canon certification or animation acceptance.

enemy-010-spitter.note: Three idle and first two death poses share a sufficiently comparable lateral head attitude. Longitudinal rigid cranial chord includes the back edge of the head shell and the forward blue-black dome tip, excluding teeth, yellow reservoir highlights, dorsal spines and arms. Death pose2 is excluded because yaw/foreshortening is greater. Move/attack are not calibrated in this pass because their head attitude and ridge shape differ; factors stay1, not a claim of verified equal size.
